description: Angular component for adding an entity via a dialog, including form handling, component creation, and interaction with entity configuration.

classes.name: AddEntityDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for adding entities, managing form state, component instantiation, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up entity configuration, creates the entity component dynamically, and prepares the form.

methods.name: helpLinkId
methods.description: Returns the help link ID based on entity form data or default resource link.

methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state, considering submission status.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Validates form, saves the entity, and closes dialog with the new entity.
